content.text:
{
  "dialogue": "Leo: okay that pizza yesterday is still on my mind
Leo: mario's absolutely hit the spot
Maya: omg yes i’m still thinking about those garlic knots
Me: same, i walked home just craving another one
Leo: i liked the pizza overall but man those olives were too salty
Maya: really? i didn’t even get olives on my slice
Me: i had like one with olives and yeah it was salty af
Leo: like i loved it otherwise, crust was perfect, just that salt bomb
Maya: lol the crying suit guy would still approve
Me: never go back to workkkk
Leo: exactly!!
Maya: did you guys end up playing that cooking game last night?
Leo: yeah for like an hour, randoms were feral again
Me: i passed out lol, pizza coma is real
Maya: same, i went straight to couch after the bus home
Leo: how was parking karma for you guys? i circled forever
Me: i just walked, 10 mins and done
Maya: bus was actually fast for once, shocking
Leo: my kitchen is a mess again btw, ecosystem reboot
Maya: nooo you just cleared it!
Me: that record lasted like two days
Leo: rude but accurate
Maya: what are you guys up to this afternoon?
Me: just dishes, again, endless cycle
Leo: put that sketch on in the background, makes it faster
Maya: never go back to workkkk
Me: it’s still stuck in my head i swear
Leo: someone at work quoted it again today?
Me: no today’s saturday, i’m free from that place
Maya: lol thank god, my laptop can’t hurt me today
Leo: did IT ever reply to you?
Maya: nope, ghosted forever
Me: classic, mine was actually okay yesterday before lunch
Maya: yeah you left on time again??
Me: well for pizza i did
Leo: priorities
Maya: ugh my legs are finally not dead from monday
Leo: leg day should still be illegal tho
Me: stairs still hurt for you?
Maya: no finally better, might actually go to gym tomorrow
Leo: look at you
Me: i’m supposed to do laundry this afternoon but i don’t wanna
Maya: join the club, mine’s piled up
Leo: mine never left the basket from last week tbh
Me: leo!!
Leo: what, i did dishes, one chore at a time
Maya: growth is slow
Me: it’s freezing again today huh
Maya: yes wore the heavy jacket to run errands
Leo: same, fall jacket uniform continues
Me: i’m still cold inside, need tea
Maya: oh i’m making tea right now actually
Leo: get me the weird lemon one virtually
Me: chamomile for me please
Maya: one weird one for leo, chamomile for you, got it
Leo: she remembers
Me: so back to mario’s tho, would you get olives again?
Leo: nah i’d skip olives next time, everything else was perfect
Maya: i’d just get extra knots and call it a meal
Me: honestly valid
Leo: the cheese pull tho, elite
Maya: okay now i’m hungry again and i just ate
Me: same, soup and toast later for me probably
Leo: grandma gang rise up
Maya: hey you had canned soup last night too
Leo: and i’d do it again
Me: i might do leftover pasta again, i’m boring
Maya: no judgment, cozy food weekend
Leo: anyone wanna do one round of that cooking game tonight?
Maya: maybe, depends how lazy i feel
Me: i could do one round later, no promises i won’t burn stuff
Leo: two fires max, house rule
Maya: hey that’s my rule
Me: lol",
  "writer_note": "Kept the pizza talk retrospective and buried it in normal Saturday afternoon chatter about chores, tea, gym soreness, and the cooking game so Leo's salty-olives opinion lands naturally without booking anything new."
}
